findings.title: descend's `movable` restriction is not applied to the reach jumps
findings.detail: `_Space.neighbours` restricts the ±step moves to `idx`, but it always appends every reach jump from `twin._walk_candidates(p, spec, reach=True)`, whatever `movable` is. So `descend(movable=[...])` can move column and slot u-coordinates that the caller did not list. The docstring says `movable` gives the 'parameter indices or names' that move, so this breaks the documented API. Only the `dies_fixed` path stays correct, and only because the jumps never touch die rows. The main use, the proxy rule and the nulls with `movable=None`, is unaffected. Any restricted-parameter caller is affected, for example an ablation, a null that moves only some parameters, or the existing test with `movable=[slot0_v0]`. The test escapes only because no jump changes slot0_v0.
findings.evidence: Scratch run on halfbridge_housing_spec(3,1), generate(...,21,reach=True)[0]. `descend(movable=[foot_HS_land_du])` with a score that also rewards moving column/slot u-coordinates took the steps slot0_free>limit (-35.5 mm), slot2_attach>col_outer, slot1_attach>limit, slot3_attach>limit and slot0_attach>col_inner. Parameters changed: slot0_u0, slot0_u1, slot1_u0, slot2_u1, slot3_u0, foot_HS_land_du.
findings.suggested_check: Drop jumps whose changed coordinate is not in `idx`, and add a test that `descend(movable=[i])` changes only parameter i.

findings.title: The search's move set is the in_domain(reach) set, not the whole DRC-feasible domain; DRC-clean seeds just outside it stop after one evaluation
findings.detail: Every candidate must pass `in_domain(spec, ., reach=True)`. That test is stricter than DRC: it replays the sampler's construction, including bounded slot heights, row gaps, free ends and landing offsets. O008's scope_in says the search's 'move set ranges over the parameterisation's whole DRC-feasible domain'. Starting from a DRC-clean seed outside in_domain, the single move that would undo the violation is often still outside the domain. The joint moves and 200 random perturbations also fail to re-enter it, so the search ends with `no_moves` and the budget unspent. The module docstring states this behaviour, so the code does what it says. But E011's A1 depends on every D_j being inside in_domain. The existing `twin.degrade` walk checks DRC only, and the docstring itself says such a walk can leave the domain.
findings.evidence: One in-domain layout (seed 21) has 37 DRC-clean single-parameter variants within ±8 grid steps that fail in_domain. I seeded local_search(budget=150) at four of them with failure reasons slot2_free_end, row_HS_gap, row_LS_u0 and slot1_free_end. Three ended `stop_reason='no_moves'` after 1 L1 evaluation and 0 perturbations, best = seed score. Examples: row_HS_gap +1.0 mm and row_LS_u0 -4 mm, each one change away from the in-domain optimum. The fourth, slot1_u1 -0.5 mm, recovered the optimum.
findings.suggested_check: Before E011, either confine the degradation family (item 3) to in_domain(reach=True) and gate on seed_in_domain, or let out-of-domain seeds take DRC-only moves that reduce the domain violation.

findings.title: Checkpoint keys do not identify the solver, spec or resolution
findings.detail: Store keys are `local:{fingerprint}:l1` and `local:{fingerprint}:lsub`. If a workdir is reused with a different l1/l_sub (another frequency, l2_layout resolution or score model), the old values are returned silently and the budget is still counted. The fingerprint covers the geometry only.
findings.evidence: local.py: `store.get(f"local:{fp}:l1", solve)` and `store.get(f"local:{fp}:lsub", ...)`; nothing about the solver is in the key or the file.
findings.suggested_check: Add a solver/config tag to the key, or write a header record and refuse a mismatch on resume.

findings.title: budget=0 or shortlist=0 crashes with an unhelpful error
findings.detail: With an empty visited set or an empty shortlist, `min(range(len(short)), ...)` raises a bare ValueError. LocalConfig does not validate either field.
findings.evidence: local.py: `bi = min(range(len(short)), key=...)` with no guard; `evaluate` raises _Budget on the seed when budget=0.
findings.suggested_check: Validate budget>=1 and shortlist>=1 in LocalConfig.__post_init__.

findings.title: The recovery test uses a separable score and passes without the domain constraint
findings.detail: test_reaches_known_feasible_optimum uses Manhattan distance to a target, which coordinate descent solves trivially. It still passes when the in_domain constraint is removed. The domain constraint is checked separately and properly by test_every_visited_layout_is_drc_clean_and_in_domain. No test uses a non-separable or inductance-like score, so the unit tests show the mechanics work, not that the search can recover headroom.
findings.evidence: Mutation (DRC-only `_Space.valid`): test_every_visited_layout... fails with 'slot2_attach'; test_reaches_known_feasible_optimum still passes.

independent_checks_performed: Ran `uv run pytest -q -m 'not slow' tests/unit/optimize`: 57 passed, 1 deselected.
Ran `uv run ruff check src/moduleforge/optimize tests/unit/optimize`: all checks passed.

Read derivative.Params/in_domain/build/params_of, twin._walk_candidates/_walk/degrade, Layout.fingerprint and search.Store. The fingerprint covers the family string, so distinct vectors give distinct fingerprints and the budget accounting is sound.
Adversarial input: `descend(movable=[foot_HS_land_du])` with a score rewarding u-coordinate moves. It took five reach jumps on slots, so the movable restriction is violated.

Adversarial input: enumerated DRC-clean but out-of-domain single-parameter variants of an in-domain layout (37 found) and seeded local_search at four. Three stopped with 'no_moves' after one evaluation.
Mutation test: replaced `_Space.valid` with a DRC-only version. The domain test catches it; the optimum-recovery test does not.
Checked spearman against the closed form 1 - 6Σd²/(n(n²-1)) on the test's example (0.8). Checked the ±step arithmetic: 0.5 and 0.125 mm steps are exact in binary, so the grid does not drift.
caveats: Valid when the search runs over the default parameter set (`movable=None` / `dies_fixed`). Restricted `movable` sets in descend are not honoured for the reach jumps.

The search moves only inside in_domain(reach=True), which is stricter than DRC feasibility. E011's control is meaningful only if every degraded copy D_j is inside that domain. Gate on stats['seed_in_domain'], or build the degradation family inside the same domain.
The cost and yield figures in the module docstring (0.013-0.016 s per L1 evaluation; yields of 68 %, 52 % and 22 %) were not reproduced. They need the 2D_Case_4 runner.
The tests use synthetic separable scores. They show the mechanics (domain, budget, determinism, resume, shortlist), not that the search can recover inductance headroom. That is E011's job.
Not checked: whether the 2D_Case_2R twin is seed_in_domain=True. The 2R test only asserts that the field is a bool.
